title: Strike reduces operations at Orvan Grain Port

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: The Realm Trade Ministry reports that dock workers at Orvan Grain Port began a strike on 14 September 2026.

source_ref.text_snippet: The Realm Trade Ministry reports that dock workers at Orvan Grain Port began a strike on 14 September 2026.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: Some grain berths are closed and the remaining berths are working at reduced speed.

source_ref.text_snippet: Some grain berths are closed and the remaining berths are working at reduced speed.

facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
facts.statement: Vessels already in the roads are being held. New arrivals may be asked to wait outside the harbour.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vessels already in the roads are being held. New arrivals may be asked to wait outside the harbour.

flagged_facts.subject: Orvan Grain Port
flagged_facts.statement: Exporters should expect delays and should not assume a quick return to normal working.

source_ref.text_snippet: Exporters should expect delays and should not assume a quick return to normal working.

validation_notes: Verifier: statement only partially supported. The statement is framed as a definitive expectation rather than a projection.
